newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks advance after hesitant opening.
newsitem.headline: French stocks advance after hesitant opening.

text.p: French stocks got off to a hesitant start on Monday as the market paused briefly to consolidate the previous week's 3.77 percent gain.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index opened almost unchanged and clung to Friday's closing levels for the first hour before advancing 7.94 points, or 0.38 percent, at 2,088.31 at 0900 GMT.
The CAC-40 September futures contract was 8.5 points higher at 2,094.
"We're seeing healthy profit-taking that's being nicely absorbed by the market," a trader said.
Shares in tyremaker Michelin were up 1.7 percent at 258.70 francs ahead of its first-half results, due early on Tuesday.

Public works group Eiffage slumped 18 percent after reporting a first-half net attributable loss of 890 million francs, forecasting a similar loss for the year and suspending its 1996 dividend. Trade in its stock was halted twice.
